         <lb n="12.15"/> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3864">byang skyabs</rs> ni dgag bya bden pa'i dngos po 'gegs pa'i cha nas don dam <lb n="12.16"/> dpyod pa'i rigs shes kyang yin la | gzhal bya sgyu ma lta bu 'jam ba'i cha nas <lb n="12.17"/> tha snyad pa'i tshad ma yin no zhes 'dod par byed na nyes pa snga ma'ang dpyad <lb n="12.18"/> par bya ba yin la | spyir cha med kyi gcig dang du ma bkag pa na de'i shul du <lb n="12.19"/> cha bcas gcig lus sam mi lus pa'ang dpyad so yin no zhes gsung so ||</seg></TEI>
